title: The Likely place for the nest
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：likely　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 likely 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the builder wrote of ① a likely place for the nest in the plan, and everybody in the site said at once that it was ② more likely than the one named there the year before. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the builder, who never explained anything, had done it in silence and gone home; it was the likely ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most likely place for the nest anybody in the site had ever seen, or so the plan for October 1966 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too likely to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the assistant who had come to help; the likely ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a likely candidate for the post, and said that no assistant in his right mind would call it ⑥ as likely as the candidate for the post they had once had in the old site. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was likely or not, and he said so.

By 1979 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the plan. What the line asked for was ⑦ something likely, and nothing besides. The assistant from the next site called the whole plan ⑧ quite likely; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the plan kept the names of the likely ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1982, twice over, she wrote of another likely place for the nest in the same plan, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ more likely than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most likely candidate for the post in the whole site, she said in 1984, was the one she could never quite name; the likely ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 可能（前置定语 a likely place for the nest：1972 年施工员在施工图里记下的那件可能的地方）
B. adj. 可能／合适（比较级 more likely than：文中两处，一处比鸟儿可能筑巢的地方，一处比预想）
C. adj. 可能／合适（最高级 the most likely：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 可能（表语 too likely to do：母亲觉得它太可能，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 合适（前置定语 a likely candidate for the post：叔叔把整件事称作一桩合适的人选）
F. adj. 合适（同级比较 as likely as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩这一职位的合适人选相比）
G. adj. 合适（后置定语 something likely：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 合适（受程度副词修饰 quite likely：那位帮工的评价）

items.q: a likely place for the nest
the most likely place for the nest anybody
a likely candidate for the post
The most likely candidate for the post in

answers.why: likely 意为“可能”，1972 年施工员在施工图里记下的是“一件可能的地方”，此处作前置定语 a likely place for the nest。
likely 意为“可能”，此处用比较级 more likely than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
likely 意为“可能”，施工图上 十月 那行字说它是工地里最可能的一件，故用最高级 the most likely place for the nest。
likely 意为“可能”，母亲认为这件东西“太可能了，谁也用不上”，too likely to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
likely 意为“合适”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩合适的人选”，此处作前置定语 a likely candidate for the post。
likely 意为“合适”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩这一职位的合适人选一样合适”，同级比较用 as likely as。
likely 意为“合适”，施工图上那半行字要的是“合适的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something likely。
likely 意为“合适”，邻工地来的那位帮工认为这套计划“相当合适”，quite 修饰原级 likely。
likely 意为“合适”，1982 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要合适”，故用比较级 more likely than。
likely 意为“合适”，母亲 1984 年说的是“整个工地里最合适的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most likely candidate for the post。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1972 年，施工员在施工图里记下了一件可能的地方。（a likely place for the nest）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更可能。（more likely than …）
母亲觉得它太可能，谁也用不上。（too likely to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩合适的人选。（a likely candidate for the post）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩这一职位的合适人选一样合适。（as likely as …）
到了 1979 年，施工图上只剩半行字：要的是一件合适的东西。（something likely）
answers: In 1972 the builder wrote of a likely place for the nest in the plan.
Everybody said it was more likely than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too likely to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a likely candidate for the post.
He said nobody would call it as likely as the candidate for the post they had once had.
By 1979 the plan asked for nothing but something likely.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 likely 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1972 the builder wrote of a likely place for the nest in the plan, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most likely place for the nest in the site, or so the plan says.
My mother thought it too likely to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a likely candidate for the post, and nobody argued with him.
The assistant from the next site called the plan quite likely, and everybody laughed.
The likely ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
